name: Internal-circulation anaerobic reactor (Paques BIOPAQ IC)
applications: high-strength industrial effluent (breweries, sugar, pulp & paper, food)
COD removal with on-site biogas production
principle: Follows the Paques BIOPAQ IC licensor flow: a tall (16-28 m) reactor treats wastewater in two stages inside one vessel. In the first stage the upflow anaerobic sludge blanket converts most COD to biogas; the gas is captured in the first separator and the rising gas-lift drives an internal circulation loop that returns the mixed liquor to the reactor bottom without external pumps. The pre-treated water then flows to a second, low-loading polishing stage with a gas separator at the top. The published Paques arrangement is: influent distribution at the bottom, first-stage granular sludge blanket, gas-liquid separator and gas-lift riser/downer forming the internal circulation, second polishing stage, treated-water outlet with optional degassing.
